overview_description.description:
Does this sound familiar?

* You start your day with 100+ unread emails.
* Your socials haven’t been touched in weeks.
* That blog post is still just a headline.
* Everything keeps getting pushed to “next week.”

=> You’re wearing too many hats: CEO, marketer, salesperson, accountant, and customer service all in one...

Meet Marblism: Your AI Employee Dream Team.

Virtual assistants who handle the busywork, so you can focus on growth.

product.name: AI Executive Assistant (EVA)
product.description: An AI assistant that manages inboxes, calendars, and drafts emails in the user's tone to streamline administrative tasks.

product.name: AI Legal Assistant (LINDA)
product.description: An AI assistant that clarifies legal documents and answers contract-related questions to aid understanding without replacing professional legal advice.

product.name: AI SEO Blog Writer (PENNY)
product.description: An AI content creator that produces SEO-optimized blog posts tailored to the user's brand voice to improve search engine rankings and audience engagement.

product.name: AI Social Media Manager (SONNY)
product.description: An AI social media manager that creates, schedules, and posts content on platforms like Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and X, adapting to the user's tone and style.

product.name: AI Customer Support Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant that manages customer support tickets, responds to inquiries, and helps resolve issues based on company documentation.

product.name: AI Sales Outreach Assistant
product.description: An AI tool that identifies leads, creates and sends cold emails and follow-ups to generate sales opportunities and convert prospects.
